extracted.name: Corn Salad
extracted.description: This corn salad is made with cold corn, colorful bell peppers, red onion, cucumber, tomato, and mayo for a creamy salad perfect for any occasion!
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen whole-kernel corn, thawed
salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Place corn, yellow pepper, red pepper, green pepper, red onion, cucumber, and tomato in a large bowl. Add just the amount of mayonnaise to your liking; mix well to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper; chill until serving.
